summary: An alternative layout puts each environment's inventory with its own group_vars and host_vars under inventories/<env>/, giving full separation of variables between environments at the cost of more files.
questions: How can I keep production and staging variables completely separate?
What is the inventories/ directory layout?
What are the downsides of a per-environment inventory directory?

answer_card.title: Per-environment inventory directories
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
inventories/
   production/
      hosts
      group_vars/
      host_vars/
   staging/
      hosts
      group_vars/
      host_vars/
library/
module_utils/
filter_plugins/
site.yml
webservers.yml
dbservers.yml
roles/
    common/
    webtier/
```

Useful when environments share few variables: it fully separates inventory variables and scales to larger setups, but means more files to maintain.
